titleEn: Three Pull Together, the Boat Glides!

pages.text: "I will pull!" Bung held a long rope in both hands on the walkway. It wrapped once round a post. At its far end, Grandpa's boat lay some way off.
"Today I will pull it to the post alone." Bung called to Grandpa. Setting cargo on the walkway, he only nodded.
Heave-ho! Bung stepped backward, pulling. The boat came a little closer. A rest, and it slid away again.
Another pull! Shaking arms, rope sliding through palms. The boat stayed where it had been.
A big boat passed far away. Waves rolled in, pushing Grandpa's boat back as far as Bung had pulled it. Hugging the rope, Bung sat down.
Ddori toddled over and took the rope in both hands. "No. You are little. I will do it." Bung yanked it back.
Bung turned to Grandpa. "Grandpa, Ddori—will you help?" Six hands on one rope. "Heave-ho!" The boat glided to the post. "Three pull together, the boat glides!"
Bung gently drew Ddori's hand close. "Your hands were strong too!" Grandpa tied the rope, smiling.
Next day, Bung called first before a heavy water tub. "One, cannot do it? Call! Two, everyone takes a hold! Three, pull together on heave-ho!" The tub slid aboard.
Grandpa wrapped his hands round theirs together. A heavy job alone felt light with three helping hands. Bung lifted Ddori's hand. "Three pull together, the boat glides!"
